message.content:
The webpage is for TOSTEM, a company focused on Japanese innovation in window design. At the top, there is a header section with the company name "TOSTEM" in a large font, followed by a tagline "Japanese Innovation in Window Design" to the right. Below the header, there is a navigation menu with several links: "ABOUT TOSTEM", "WHY TOSTEM", "OUR PRODUCTS", "OUR EXPERIENCE", and "REACH US", each with a dropdown arrow indicating additional content.

In the center of the page, there is a prominent modal dialog box with a white background, titled "BOOK AN APPOINTMENT" in bold font. The modal has a close button (X) at the top right corner. Inside the modal, there is a form with several input fields: "Enter your name" (a text input), "Enter your email address" (a text input), "Enter your mobile number" (a text input), "City" (a text input), and "Select State" (a dropdown menu). Below these, there are two more dropdown menus: "Are you a" and "You are looking for". At the bottom of the form, there is a "SUBMIT" button in black.

At the bottom of the page, there is a cookie consent notification with a message explaining the use of cookies on the website. The notification has two buttons: "Cookie settings" and "ACCEPT".

On the left side of the page, there is a vertical button or link labeled "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE", and on the right side, there is another vertical button or link labeled "ENQUIRE NOW". There is also a small icon or button at the top right corner of the page, possibly a search or menu icon.

The overall layout is clean and organized, with a focus on the appointment booking form and the company's branding. The color scheme is primarily black, white, and gray, with some blue accents.
